protocol.scope: Authored PiPER free-block contact task, synthetic scenes and privileged native state. No learned policy, shoe competence, calibrated contact or physical robot qualification.
protocol.timing_boundary: Attempt wall includes asset verification, compilation, settling, authored planning/IK, physics, contact scoring and recorded state construction. Protocol/report/trace disk serialization, rendering, training, physical sensing, transport and actuation are excluded. Control computation windows are not sensor-to-actuator reaction times.
protocol.comparison: Open-jaw replays the complete valid placement requested-arm tape with jaw target .035 m; hold requests the initial six arm targets and an open jaw. Invalid or incomplete placement tapes leave a retained invalid open-jaw attempt; they are never extended.
protocol.split_note: Synthetic seeded scenes; repeats are not physical trials. Confirmation is a declaration, not proof that these scenes were unseen during development.

hardware.memory_scope: Process lifetime high-water RSS before final inspection/export, not per-episode memory or minimum RAM; null unavailable.
